entities.summary: Nandivarman II (718–796) was a Pallava monarch who reigned in southern India. Sen states Nandivarman reigned from 731 to 796 and built the Vaikuntha-Perumal Temple. He was born in the country of Champa, in Simhapura into a local dynasty of Pallava origin and was elected as the Pallava monarch at the age of 13.
